title: Hematological disorders treated by bone marrow or stem cell transplantation
summary: Bone marrow or stem cell transplantation for hematological disorder; considered disabled for 12 months from date of transplantation, after which residual impairment is evaluated.

children.criterion: Bone marrow or hematopoietic stem cell transplantation for a hematological disorder
Within 12 months of transplant date (claimant considered disabled for 12 months post-transplant)
